18.sourceTitle: Amazon.com: Wolf Tooth Tubeless Valve Stem Kit for Clik Valve - 44mm Black
18.evidenceText: Wolf Tooth Tubeless Valve Stem Kits are fitted with Clik Valve cores. Clik Valve is an alternative tubeless valve core option to Presta. Tubeless Valve Stems for Clik Valve are compatible with tubeless rims that are drilled for Presta valves. They are available in 44 and 60 mm lengths, and in nine colors.
18.extractionRationale: One distinct third-party accessory product identified: Wolf Tooth Tubeless Valve Stem Kit explicitly designed for Clik Valve compatibility. Multiple size and color variants exist but represent variations of a single product line.

45.evidenceText: DT Swiss GRC 1400 DICUT specifications show "TL valve alu black 49-65 mm" - traditional aluminum tubeless valve, not Clik. Hunt Wheels article discusses tubeless-ready technology but does not mention Clik valve adoption.
45.extractionRationale: The available evidence shows DT Swiss using traditional aluminum tubeless valves in their current gravel wheel line. Hunt Wheels information does not reference Clik valves. No evidence from any of the 6 major brands (DT Swiss, Mavic, Hunt, Zipp, ENVE, Roval) demonstrates Clik valve adoption in 2026/2027 product lines. Therefore, 0% of brands shown have converted to Clik as standard.
